poll.question: Day 15, evening. Dan and Hui Ling sit close by the fire—steadier than yesterday. A voice calls from the rooftop, asking for shelter. Do they:

options.label: Open the ramp
options.desc: Extend their healing to one more person. They don't just survive—they choose to help.

options.label: Stay sealed
options.desc: Protect the fragile steadiness they've just found. They're barely alive—they can't save anyone else.

in_play.label: Finish repairs, leave at daw
in_play.desc: Trust his careful hands. Trust preparation.
